description: Count a form's submissions matching the same filters as fillout_list_submissions (date range, status, search) without pulling the answers — e.g. 'how many responses this week?' or 'how many partial submissions?'. Reads totalResponses from GET /forms/{formId}/submissions with limit=1.

afterDate.description: Only submissions submitted after this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

beforeDate.description: Only submissions submitted before this ISO 8601 date-time.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

name: fillout_count_submissions
title: Count submissions
